first_error_behavior: Validate stops at the first blocking source-ordered failure, except Zip and overpayment branches only alert; Save runs a narrower graph.

rules.condition: Year-end components do not form a valid MM/DD/YYYY date.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: Please provide a valid date (MM/DD/YYYY format) on Item 1
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops the active operation.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Retain as a structured revision-aware error.

rules.condition: Year-end month is 00 with otherwise parseable components.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: validateDate rejects month below 0 rather than below 1, so month 00 can roll into the previous year.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require month 01 through 12.

rules.condition: Year end is before July 1, 2001.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: Valid input for the Month and Year is June 2001 onwards on Item 1.
rules.official_behavior: The code uses July 1, 2001 while the message says June 2001 onwards.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Align the cutoff and message to the authoritative revision rule.

rules.condition: Year end is after today.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: Year Ended should not be a future date on Item 1.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops the active operation.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Retain as a structured revision-aware error.

rules.condition: Fiscal is selected and year-end month is December.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: Month cannot be equal to December on Item 1.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops the active operation.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Retain as a structured revision-aware error.

rules.condition: Year end is on or before March 31, 2021.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: Year shall not be greater than the present year and not earlier than April 2021.
rules.official_behavior: The branch replaces the year with current year minus one, and the message describes only a year despite a full-date cutoff.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Preserve user input and state the exact revision cutoff.

rules.condition: Neither individual nor corporation ATC is selected.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: Please select an ATC Code on Item 5.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops the active operation.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Retain as a structured revision-aware error.

rules.condition: Individual ATC and Fiscal are both selected.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: If you are filing as Individual, please select Calendar on item 1.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops the active operation.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Retain as a structured revision-aware error.

rules.condition: RDO is 000.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: Please provide a valid RDO Code on Item 7.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops the active operation.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Retain as a structured revision-aware error.

rules.condition: Registered name is blank.

rules.exact_message: Please provide a valid Line of Business/Occupation on Item 8.
rules.official_behavior: The message labels the registered-name field as Line of Business/Occupation.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Name the field as registered name.

rules.condition: Registered address is blank.

rules.exact_message: Zip Code is required, please validate your registration information and update accordingly using BIR Form 1905, if necessary.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts but does not return false, so validation continues.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Return false after the alert.

rules.exact_message: Please choose at least one from item 12.

rules.condition: Tax still payable is parenthesized negative.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: You have a negative value for Part 2 Item 19. \n\nIn case of overpayment apply for tax refund using BIR Form No. 1914 (Application for Tax Credits/Refunds)
rules.official_behavior: The alert is shown but return false is commented out, so Validate succeeds.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Represent the overpayment separately and require an explicit disposition if applicable.

rules.condition: Applicable tax rate is at least 100.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: Tax rate should be below 100.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops the active operation.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Retain as a structured revision-aware error.

rules.condition: Applicable tax rate is negative.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: Only the upper bound is checked, so a negative rate is accepted.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require a rate from zero through less than 100.

rules.condition: RDO is 000.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: Please select an RDO Code on Item 6.
rules.official_behavior: Save labels the RDO as Item 6 while Validate labels it Item 7.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use the printed item number consistently.

rules.condition: ATC, version cutoff, treaty, schedule, Zip, or overpayment validation fails.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: Save bypasses most of the Validate graph.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use a shared validation graph with explicit phase exceptions.
